# Shooting state table

Stock shooting-sequencer state table: 34 entries of 20 bytes, states 0 to 33.

**Category:** table · **Address:** `0x6044f9e4` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Each entry is id, name, handler and two event tables. To add states, copy the table, repoint its two loads and raise the range check at 0x602a1347.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Layout, loads and range check read from the dispatcher. Source: [E-M5 III shooting sequencer](../sources/em5n.sequencer.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): A relocated table with extra states runs on the camera. Source: [E-M5 III shooting sequencer](../sources/em5n.sequencer.md).
